title: How to Convert Airtime to Cash in Nigeria: A Safe & Fast Guide
excerpt: Over-recharged your phone by mistake? Learn the fastest and safest ways to convert MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile airtime back to cash directly into your bank account.

sections.content: Understanding the Conversion Rates & Discount Dynamics

No platform converts airtime to cash at a 100% rate. Because telecom networks charge processing fees and the platform must cover transaction costs, you will receive a percentage of the airtime's face value. For instance, MTN usually has the best rate (around 80% to 85%), meaning a ₦10,000 airtime transfer will yield ₦8,000 to ₦8,500 cash in your bank. Glo, Airtel, and 9mobile tend to have slightly lower rates (around 70% to 75%) due to lower demand and different network commission structures. These rates are dynamic and can adjust based on market volumes, reflecting current aggregator balances, helping you budget your conversions, ensuring you know your returns before submitting, keeping bookkeeping accurate, preventing losses, keeping accounting clean, protecting margins.

Aggregators typically pool the airtime they receive to sell to enterprise companies who use it for bulk SMS campaigns, call center lines, or corporate recharge packages. Because these transactions involve several clearing intermediaries, the discount is necessary to cover routing charges, database verification, and bank transfer fees, making it a structured market, keeping the ecosystem sustainable for all operators, ensuring liquidity, preventing credit wastage, maintaining steady trade volumes, ensuring reliability.
Requirements to Convert Airtime to Cash
To successfully complete a conversion, ensure you have these prerequisites in place:

items: Share and Sell PIN: You must configure and know your network's transfer PIN (e.g. MTN Share & Sell PIN) to authorize the transfer.
Minimum Transfer Balance: Most portals set a minimum limit of ₦500 to ₦1,000 airtime to initiate a conversion.
Main Account Balance: You can only transfer funds from your main airtime balance. Promotional balances or bonus credits cannot be converted.
Registered Portal Account: You need an account on a verified platform like Ufriends IT to receive the cash settlements.

sections.content: Step-by-Step Guide to Converting Airtime on Ufriends IT
If you have accidentally over-recharged, follow these steps on Ufriends IT to convert it to cash:

steps.title: Log Into Ufriends IT
steps.content: Go to Ufriends.com.ng and log into your reseller dashboard.

steps.title: Select Airtime to Cash
steps.content: Navigate to the **Airtime to Cash** tab, select the network provider, and enter the phone number you are sending from.

steps.title: Confirm Value and Get Transfer Number
steps.content: Input the airtime amount you want to convert. The system displays the exact cash value you will receive and generates a destination phone number.

steps.title: Execute the USSD Transfer Command
steps.content: Dial your network's transfer command (e.g. `*321*destination-number*amount*PIN#` for MTN) to transfer the airtime.

steps.title: Confirm and Receive Cash
steps.content: Click 'I have transferred' on the portal. The system verifies the database and credits your wallet within minutes. You can then withdraw to your bank account.

Once you transfer your airtime to an unverified phone number, the scammer blocks your account. Because telecom networks do not support reversals on airtime transfers, your funds are permanently lost. sections.content: Network Transfer PIN Configurations for MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile
Before you can transfer airtime, you must activate the transfer service on your SIM card. Here is how to configure your PIN for each network:

items: MTN (Share & Sell): Dial `*321#` to change the default PIN (0000) to a secure 4-digit code. Alternatively, send an SMS with 'defaultPIN newPIN newPIN' to 321.
Airtel (Me2U): Change the default PIN (1234) by dialing `*312#` or sending an SMS with 'PIN 1234 newPIN' to 141.
Glo (EasyShare): Change the default PIN (0000) by dialing `*131*defaultPIN*newPIN*newPIN#`.
9mobile (Lintel): Change the default PIN (0000) by dialing `*223*defaultPIN*newPIN#`.

sections.content: Common Mistakes to Avoid When Flipping Credit

items: Sending Airtime to Old Numbers: Destination phone numbers generated by Ufriends IT are rotated automatically. Always check your dashboard for a fresh transfer number before initiating a transfer.
Attempting to Transfer Bonus Balance: Promos like MTN BetaTalk bonus or Glo 22X bonus are virtual numbers that cannot be sent to other subscribers. Only main balances are accepted.
Forgetting to Click Confirm: If you transfer the airtime but fail to click 'I have transferred' on your dashboard, the transaction will not sync, delaying your payout.

sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How long does the cash take to reflect in my bank? Once confirmed on Ufriends IT, the funds reflect in your wallet instantly and can be withdrawn immediately.
Can I convert borrowed airtime? No, you must repay any active airtime loans before you can transfer credits.
What is the funding fee on Ufriends IT? Ufriends IT charges a simple 1% fee on automated virtual bank transfers, with funds crediting in under 15 seconds.
Is there a limit to how much airtime I can convert? Yes, daily limits depend on your KYC tier. Upgrading your account increases your daily limits.
What happens if I type the destination number wrong? If you transfer to the wrong number, the airtime goes to another user and cannot be recovered.
Can I print NIN slips on Ufriends? Yes, NIN slips and BVN slips can be retrieved and printed under the main dashboard.
Do you support Glo conversions? Yes, Ufriends IT supports airtime to cash conversions for MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile.
Is there a registration fee? No, creating a reseller account on Ufriends IT is free.
Can I automate conversions via APIs? Yes, developers can integrate our airtime APIs to automate conversions on their portals.
Why was my transaction queried? A transaction is queried if the transferred amount does not match the value entered on the dashboard.
How do I contact customer support? Click the WhatsApp support link on your dashboard to connect with an agent.
